jei.monstrous_world.darkened_iron_ingot_:
The Darkened Iron Ingot is created by combining Dark Essence Dust and a regular Iron Ingot in a crafting grid. The recipe is shapeless.

Dark Essence Dust is occasionally dropped when mining Darkened Blocks, although Darkened Leaves by far offer the best chance of a drop.
jei.monstrous_world.blood_bottles:
Blood Bottles are useful for Vampires , for trading with Vampires, and in some magic.

Blood Bottles are obtained in three ways:

1. By clicking on a filled Blood Bulb plant with a glass bottle
2. By right-clicking some beings with a Bloodletter while holding an empty glass bottle in your off hand
3. By trading with first-generation Vampires in the Vampire Manor as a Vampire yourself
jei.monstrous_world.simple_cauldron_info:
The Simple Cauldron is a workstation limited to the Witch/Warlock faction.

Recipes can be found throughout the world as Dropped Notebooks, which yield a random brewing recipe upon right-clicking. 

For these reasons, using Simple Cauldron recipes through JEI is disabled to prevent cheating.
jei.monstrous_world.advanced_cauldron_in:
The Advanced Cauldron is limited to use by Witches and Warlocks of at least Level 5.

Information on use is found in the Tome of Witchery, and in recipes obtained by opening Dropped Notebooks, which are found throughout the world on the ground.

JEI recipes for magical powders are disabled to prevent cheating or use by the wrong faction.
jei.monstrous_world.charm_altar_info:
The Charm Altar is limited to use by Level 2+ Witches and Warlocks.

Instructions on use are found in the Tome of Witchery.

JEI recipes are disabled for this workstation to prevent cheating.
jei.monstrous_world.goblin_workstation_i:
The Goblin Workstation is only usable by Level 2+ Goblins.

This Workstation can modify some vanilla and Monstrous World tools with Precious Stones, among other things. The Tome of the Goblin contains instructions for use as well as a few item recipes.

This Workstation's recipes are not enabled in JEI to prevent cheating.
jei.monstrous_world.goblin_oven_info:
The Goblin Oven is only usable by the Goblin faction. 

This Oven can bake magical Pumpkin Cookies with both good and bad effects. Instructions are available in the Tome of the Goblin.

Oven recipes are disabled in JEI to prevent cheating.
jei.monstrous_world.dark_essence_dust_in:
Dark Essence Dust is a magical material that occasionally drops from broken, natural Darkened Blocks such as Darkened Dirt and Darkened Logs.

It most often drops from Darkened Leaves, and from newly infected blocks that still have animated textures. 

This essence can alter some blocks upon right-clicking them, and has magical applications as well.
jei.monstrous_world.cassiterite_info: Cassiterite is the ore that is smelted into tin ingots. It is useful for multiple monster factions, and the ore is found in shallow caves and high elevations.
jei.monstrous_world.tin_ingot_info:
Tin Ingots are made by smelting Cassiterite, an ore found in shallow caves. They are valued by Mad Scientists, and are useful as trade items. 

This item should be compatible with any recipes that require Tin Ingots.
jei.monstrous_world.silver_info:
Silver is a holy metal, and also useful in magic. It is valued by Hunters and some magic users.

Silver is found deep underground, and the ore drops both nuggets and dust. These items should be interchangeable with silver nuggets and dust from other mods.
jei.monstrous_world.malachite_info:
Malachite is a Precious Stone. It has no ore, but rather appears occasionally in copper deposits when mined.

Malachite is valued for its cleansing properties.
jei.monstrous_world.moonstone_info:
Moonstone is a Precious Stone found in higher elevations, and its ore has a bluish-white hue.

Moonstone is associated with night, and is useful in magic. Moonstone artifacts can also mesmerize Werewolves when held, giving the holder a bit of protection.
jei.monstrous_world.tigers_eye_info:
Tiger's Eye is a Precious Stone found in shallow caves in dry regions. It is a stone of protection against evil spirits.

Tiger's Eye is used in magic, by Goblins, and in trading.
jei.monstrous_world.agate_info:
Agates are Precious Stones valued by multiple monster factions. Different colors have different properties.

Agates are found on the surface, appearing as oddly-colored gravel deposits. They must be mined with an Iron Shovel or higher tier to yield an Agate. Different regions will have different colored Agates, with some areas having more than one type.
jei.monstrous_world.quartz_info:
Clear Quartz and Rose Quartz are both Precious Stones. The clear variety is common, and good for various types of magic and modding weapons.

Rose Quartz is rarer and associated with healing, and the ore appears in flowery biomes.
jei.monstrous_world.black_onyx_and_sardo:
Black Onyx and Sardoynx are two variants of Onyx, and are both Precious Stones. The ores are found deep underground and are fairly common.

Onyx stones are associated with strength and attack, and are valued by multiple monster factions.
jei.monstrous_world.nether_gem_info:
Nether Gems are dense concentrations of the Nether's pure, fiery energy. The red ore is found only in the Nether.

This is the only Precious Stone found in the Nether, and is associated with fire.
jei.monstrous_world.swamp_crystal_info:
Swamp Crystals are pure concentrations of Swamp Essence, the murky energy of swamps, which is in turn an evolved form of Dark Essence.  The glowing green ore is only found in shallow swamp caves.

These crystals are toxic to most beings, and can only be used by one monster faction.
jei.monstrous_world.pumpkin_essence_info:
Pumpkin Essence is a common magical dust dropped by Vengeful Pumpkins. It is not dangerous, and can be right-clicked on regular Pumpkins to change their type.

Pumpkin Essence is useful in many types of magic.
jei.monstrous_world.spirit_dust_informat:
Spirit Dust,  or Spirit Essence, is dropped by various types of Evil Sprits when defeated. This cold dust can alter torches, campfires, and lanterns on right-clicking them.

Spirit Dust is useful in many types of magic.
jei.monstrous_world.a_hint_of_insanity_i:
A Hint of Insanity is a dangerous magical dust dropped by Dreadful Watchers and one monstrous plant. It occasionally drops from Murkwood Leaves. Consuming it may not be good for the mind...

This magical dust has many uses by different monster factions.
jei.monstrous_world.undeathly_essence_in:
This green dust is an evolved form of Dark Essence, and carries the cold, lifeless energy of undeath. It is collected from the undead themselves by the Deathcatcher plant, which can then be harvested for this dust. It is also occasionally dropped by Deathly Trees and given off by Grave Soil. 

Undeathly Essence is used in various types of magic.
jei.monstrous_world.a_hint_of_sanity:
A Hint of Sanity is a golden dust created by combining a Golden Apple with a Hint of Insanity. This purifies the dust, which is used in some recipes.

Cookies made with this dust can cure the insanity and paranoia inflicted by Dreadful Watchers.
